title: Play Dough
directions: Put mixture II into mixture I.
Cook until mixture comes away from sides of pan (4-5 min.)
Knead dough on wax paper.
notes: Written on lined notepaper, stained
raw_text:
Play Dough - Pat Jeffray
Mixture I
2 c flour
1 c salt
4 tsp. cream of tartar
Mix well
Mixture II
2 c. water
2 tbsp. oil
food coloring
Mix well
Put mixture II into mixture I. Cook
until mixture comes away from sides of
pan (4-5 min.) Knead dough on wax
paper.

title: Quick tips for lamb
ingredients: Herbs: Rosemary, lemon thyme, oregano, marjoram, basil, tarragon, mint.
Spices: Curry powder, cumin, ginger, caraway, paprika.
Flavorings: Garlic, grated rind and juice of orange and lemon, red currant jelly, olive oil, soy sauce, wine, port, Madeira.
directions: Make shallow cuts in skin of lamb roast and insert slivers of peeled garlic. Rub surface with mixture of salt, pepper and powdered rosemary. Sprinkle with a little olive oil and lemon juice.
notes: Newspaper clipping taped to a lined card
Handwritten sideways in red at right: LAMB - FLAVORINGS
raw_text:
Quick tips
for lamb
Here are some flavor combinations that enhance lamb, along with techniques for applying them:
■ Herbs: Rosemary, lemon thyme, oregano, marjoram, basil, tarragon, mint.
■ Spices: Curry powder, cumin, ginger, caraway, paprika.
■ Flavorings: Garlic, grated rind and juice of orange and lemon, red currant jelly, olive oil, soy sauce, wine, port, Madeira.
■ Make shallow cuts in skin of lamb roast and insert slivers of peeled garlic. Rub surface with mixture of salt, pepper and powdered rosemary. Sprinkle with a little olive oil and lemon juice.
— CP
[handwritten sideways in red:] LAMB - FLAVORINGS
